subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate OpenSSF Best Practices & Tooling into OpenClaw

question: Which remaining OpenSSF supply-chain controls should OpenClaw adopt now, and which should be deferred, replaced by existing safeguards, or handled through repository or organization administration outside the source tree?
rationale: The remaining work changes trusted CI execution, release identity, scanner gates, repository or organization policy, and artifact trust, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent security posture or rollout order.

options.title: Split And Phase Selected Controls
options.body: Keep this umbrella open, split owner-approved slices for Scorecard or badges, SECURITY-INSIGHTS, scanner gates, release attestations, and org settings, and validate each slice on the relevant workflow or release path.

options.title: Keep As Tracking Only
options.body: Use this issue as a standing security roadmap item and require separate maintainer-authored issues or PRs before implementation work starts.

options.title: Defer OpenSSF Program
options.body: Pause the OpenSSF-specific program only if maintainers explicitly decide current SECURITY.md, Dependabot, Dependency Guard, CodeQL, provenance, and attestations are sufficient substitutes for now.

recommendation.title: Split And Phase Selected Controls
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open, split owner-approved slices for Scorecard or badges, SECURITY-INSIGHTS, scanner gates, release attestations, and org settings, and validate each slice on the relevant workflow or release path.

likelyOwner.reason: He is listed as project lead, owns the CODEOWNERS routing rules, and already engaged on this tracker, making him the best available owner for cross-cutting security, release, and admin direction.
